connector.name: Plumb MCP
connector.registryDescription: Two-way Figma MCP: extract + verify design-to-code, or generate on-brand Figma pages from a prompt.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package plumb-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the tathagat22 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FIGMA_TOKEN
env.description: Figma personal access token (read-only). Only needed for the REST path — not required when the Plumb plugin is paired in Figma desktop. Create one at figma.com → Settings → Security → Personal access tokens.

env.name: PLUMB_SESSION_NAME
env.description: Optional label shown in the Plumb Figma plugin when multiple plumb-mcp servers are paired with the same plugin (multi-agent connect). Defaults to the basename of the current working directory.
